hotels.title: Ultimate Malta Glamour: 20-Storey Meliá Luxury with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Drinks & Daily Credit
hotels.description: Striking architecture, sky-high cocktails and glossy poolside living make ME Malta one of St. Julian’s most distinctive stays. Set within a 20-storey tower designed by Zaha Hadid, the five-star hotel pairs bold interiors with sweeping views, a stylish Cabana Club and the 20th-floor Radio Rooftop, where 360-degree panoramas stretch across the coast and city. Wellness is just as considered, with Dee Spas offering a sleek retreat and water circuit, while dining spans Italian favourites at Luciano by Gino D’Acampo and evenings high above St. Julian’s at Radio Rooftop. The hotel also taps into Malta’s creative side with a program of art, fashion, music and cultural events woven into the stay. Step outside and you’re in the heart of St. Julian’s, close to St. George’s Bay, Portomaso marina, restaurants and nightlife, with Valletta also within easy reach. It’s a polished base for travelers who want Malta’s energy at their doorstep without sacrificing standout design, elevated dining and plenty of space to switch off.
